opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning (research, hotel, activities, dinner, note, email draft)
opportunities.description: For a given city and dates, gather population (Wikipedia), weather (timeanddate), a hotel (Booking), two activities (Viator), a dinner reservation (restaurant site), then save a summary note and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant), notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article for population
Search the city on timeanddate and open current weather
On Booking, enter the city as destination, select dates, (set travelers), search
Open a hotel result and view Info & prices
On Viator, search for activity 1 in the city and open a result
On Viator, search for activity 2 in the city and open a result
On the restaurant site, enter city and cuisine, pick the date, search, open a restaurant
In Notes, create a new note summarizing city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities, dinner
In Mail, enter recipient, subject and body with the plan, then discard/finish the draft

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for destination and dates
opportunities.description: Clear the destination on Booking, enter a new city, choose check-in/out dates and travelers, search, open a hotel and view prices.
steps: Click Clear on the destination field
Type the city and choose the suggested option
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out
Set number of travelers and click Done
Open a hotel result and click Info & prices
